checkpoint_cut: A checkpoint-creating lane zero defers lane one; lane one otherwise terminates the bundle naturally.
allocation: Select lowest available nonzero tags from the pre-cycle free set; commit releases are available next cycle. p0 is never allocated.
acceptance: Accept the complete selected prefix only when all physical destinations exist and resources_ready_i is true. Invalid lane-one-only input is rejected. Reset and recovery suppress all outputs.
dependencies: Sources use the map before their own destination write. Lane one observes lane zero's nonzero destination for RAW and stale-tag WAW; forwarded sources are not ready.
inputs: The owner supplies a legal injective RAT with x0 mapped to p0, ready p0, and no mapped register free. ready_i includes any accepted writeback bypass. resources_ready_i covers the selected prefix's ROB/IQ/LQ/SQ/checkpoint reservations.
outputs: All metadata is zero for unaccepted lanes. source_ready_o uses rs1 then rs2 per lane. allocation_o contains only accepted nonzero destinations.
scope: Combinational bundle planning only. RAT/free-list storage, committed-map updates, checkpoint snapshots, recovery ownership, and pipeline integration remain separate tasks.
